Same failure on a rented machine, seen by MTG-193 (2026-10-27/28, controller etude-sdk 0.2.6): lost run 6ed5413f5292 (pod create HTTP 400, no pod at RunPod) left session cpu32-b937fa5a80b7 with no receipt. Its rental window ended 2026-10-28 00:08 UTC. Scheduler._observe then finishes its attempts as lost (create_unconfirmed) but returns without _end_session, so unsettled_sessions keeps counting it; `etude terminate` does not clear it. Every cpu32 quote since then says 'at its machine limit' (rechecked 04:26 UTC). Etude main v0.2.11 (36c6656) has the same branch at src/etude/launch/scheduler.py:1898-1902. Proposed fix: once a receipt-less session's deadline has passed, end it (or record a refusal) after its attempts are finished. This blocks MTG-193's cpu32 calibration arm.
